notes: Local, on the host: not a GitHub-hosted runner and not the 4-CPU container emulation of RUN-ci-fastlane. The fast lane ran fast.yml steps 5 and 6 with CI=true and without the privacy secrets, as a pull request from a fork would; steps 1 to 4 (clock, checkout, Node and uv setup) were the host itself, with the same Node and uv versions as the workflow pins.

Recorded by the W0 integration, after every W0 task had finished and after the integration changes listed in docs/waves/W0-report.md section 3; runs/index.json was regenerated just before this run and again after this record was written.

The fast lane is red on two known findings and nothing else: GATE-links, SCR-instrument implemented by no task (spine section 13 gives it to W1-T14; W0-T10 adds it), and GATE-privacy, vendor/kernelspace/ without a license file (owner decision OD-16).

The release-mode configurations are informational for W0-T11: the release lane fails on GATE-numbers known debt, pending ID proposals, GATE-budget warnings, forward run references, inputs changed since their runs, and the missing course licenses and term list.

Outputs are normalised: the repository path is <repo>, the scratch directory <scratch>, temporary directories <tmp>, the home directory <home>, store paths <nix-store>, and the local account and git identity <user>. The outputs were staged outside runs/ while the gates ran and copied here afterwards.
The commands in configs[].argv reproduce the run from the repository root; the script that ran them and wrote this record is not part of the repository.
